audit.notes: Very easy format to adapt. Pair any casual, aesthetic 5-second b-roll (subway commute, working in a cafe, walking through NYC) with a high-stakes niche hook ('X things every New Yorker / climber / freelancer will regret not knowing') and deliver the actual value in the caption.
